summary: Design visual systems, interfaces, motion, art, and shaders.

skills.choose_when: The primary deliverable is an original static poster, cover, artwork, or print composition.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for application UI, charts, slide decks, or image editing requiring a dedicated generation tool.
skills.name: create-visual-art

skills.choose_when: The task is interface hierarchy, responsive layout, component design, UI polish, or implementation-aware frontend design.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for a static poster, presentation, or backend-only task.
skills.name: design-frontend

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly concerns UI animation, transition timing, easing, motion audit, or reduced-motion behavior.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for video editing or animation unrelated to interface behavior.
skills.name: design-motion

skills.choose_when: The task needs reusable color, typography, spacing, style tokens, or a visual theme across artifacts.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use when only one isolated color value or font choice is requested.
skills.name: design-visual-theme

skills.choose_when: The task explicitly involves GLSL, HLSL, WGSL, GPU materials, post-processing, or real-time shader performance.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary CSS effects or offline image editing.
skills.name: develop-shaders
